title: Where LocalScripts Can Run
summary: LocalScripts only run in client-owned containers: StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts, StarterCharacterScripts, PlayerGui, PlayerScripts, Backpack/character tools, and ReplicatedFirst. Parked elsewhere (e.g. Workspace or ServerScriptService) they silently never run.

explanation.whatItIs: The placement contract: the engine copies client scripts from specific containers into the player's world at the right moment. Outside those containers, nothing happens — no error, just silence.
explanation.whyItExists: Client code must enter each client's world at a defined lifecycle point; arbitrary placement would race with replication.
whenToUse: StarterPlayerScripts: general client systems (runs once per client)
StarterCharacterScripts: per-respawn client logic (re-runs each spawn!)
PlayerGui/Backpack: scripts that live with the GUI/tool
whenNotToUse: Dropping LocalScripts into Workspace or ServerStorage 'for organization' — they won't run
tips: Need code in a weird place? Put a LocalScript in a valid home that REQUIRES a ModuleScript parked anywhere
StarterCharacterScripts re-run per spawn — don't double-register connections there
Server Scripts likewise need their own valid homes (ServerScriptService, Workspace, tools…)
commonMistakes: LocalScript in ReplicatedStorage expecting it to run — it's only a storage spot; clients can require its modules but won't auto-run it
Confusing 'replicated to clients' with 'runs on clients'
Per-spawn duplication from StarterCharacterScripts without guards

examples.title: Correct homes
examples.code:
-- ✅ Runs:
-- StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/ClientMain.lua  (LocalScript)
-- StarterGui/HUD/Controller  (LocalScript inside a ScreenGui)
-- Backpack/Sword/Client  (LocalScript in a Tool)

-- ❌ Never runs:
-- Workspace/MyLocal  (LocalScript)
-- ServerScriptService/ClientStuff  (wrong universe)
-- ReplicatedStorage/AutoRun  (storage only)

-- ✅ The escape hatch — valid home requires anywhere module:
-- (StarterPlayerScripts) LocalScript:
local MyModule = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.CoolModule)
MyModule.start()
